
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Marktowin/p/19520721" title="发布于 2026-01-23 10:15">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">玩转 ZooKeeper之分布式锁</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p dir="auto">上一篇已经给出了选举leader执行任务的案例，接下来将<strong>领导者选举</strong>例子改成<strong>分布式锁（Distributed Lock）</strong>的实现方式。 模拟一个<strong>高并发扣减库存</strong>的场景：多个节点同时抢购同一商品（库存=100），使用 ZooKeeper 分布式锁确保<strong>同一时刻只有一个节点能扣库存</strong>，避免超卖。</p>
<p dir="auto">核心区别回顾：</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>领导者选举</strong>：全局只有一个 Leader <strong>长期持有</strong>，一直执行任务。</li>
<li><strong>分布式锁</strong>：谁需要操作资源就去<strong>抢锁</strong>，<strong>用完立即释放</strong>，其他节点可以继续抢。</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>distributed-lock-service/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
├── pom.xml
├── src</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│   └── main</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│       ├── java</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│       │   └── com</span>/example/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│       │       ├── DistributedLock.java  </span>//<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分布式锁核心
│       │       ├── InventoryService.java </span>//<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 库存扣减服务
│       │       └── App.java             </span>//<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 主入口
│       └── resources</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
│           └── application.properties</span></pre>
</div>

<p dir="auto">2. 核心代码</p>
<p dir="auto">DistributedLock.java（基于 Curator 的可重入公平分布式锁）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         //<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Curator 客户端（带重试机制）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         ExponentialBackoffRetry retryPolicy = new ExponentialBackoffRetry(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1000</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>         this.client = CuratorFrameworkFactory.newClient(zkConnectString, sessionTimeout, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3000</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, retryPolicy);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>         this.lock =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> new InterProcessMutex(client, lockPath);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>     /**
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span>      * 尝试获取锁，超时则返回 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span>      */
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    public boolean acquire(long timeout, TimeUnit unit) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        try {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span>             boolean acquired =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lock.acquire(timeout, unit);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (acquired) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span>                 logger.info(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Lock acquired: {}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, lockPath);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">39</span>             } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">40</span>                 logger.warn(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Failed to acquire lock within timeout: {}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, lockPath);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">41</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> acquired;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">43</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        } catch (Exception e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">44</span>             logger.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">error</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error acquiring lock</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">45</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">49</span>     /**
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">50</span>      *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 释放锁
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">51</span>      */
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">52</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    public void release() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">53</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        try {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">54</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (lock.isAcquiredInThisProcess()) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">55</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                lock.release();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">56</span>                 logger.info(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Lock released: {}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, lockPath);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">57</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">58</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        } catch (Exception e) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">59</span>             logger.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">error</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error releasing lock</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">60</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">61</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">62</span>

<p dir="auto">App.java（主入口：模拟 10 个并发请求抢锁）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">package com.example;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import java.io.IOException;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import java.util.Properties;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">public class App {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         Properties props =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> new Properties();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         props.<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">load</span>(App.class.getClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">application.properties</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         String zkConnect = props.getProperty(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zk.connectString</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         int sessionTimeout = Integer.parseInt(props.getProperty(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">zk.sessionTimeout</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         String lockPath = props.getProperty(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">lock.path</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>         InventoryService inventory =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> new InventoryService();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>         DistributedLock lock =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> new DistributedLock(zkConnect, sessionTimeout, lockPath);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         // 模拟 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 个并发请求（实际生产中来自不同服务实例或线程）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (int i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>; i++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>             final int orderId = i + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>             executor.submit(() -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>                 System.out.println(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">订单 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + orderId + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> 开始尝试扣库存...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>                 // 尝试获取锁（超时 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 秒）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (lock.acquire(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    try {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>                         //<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 临界区：扣库存
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span>                         inventory.deductStock(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    } finally {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span>                         //<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 必须释放锁！
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                        lock.release();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span>                 } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span>                     System.out.println(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">订单 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> + orderId + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)"> 获取锁超时，放弃本次扣减</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">39</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">40</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            });
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">41</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">43</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        executor.shutdown();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">44</span>         executor.awaitTermination(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">45</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span>         System.out.println(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">最终剩余库存: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> inventory.getStock());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        lock.close();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">49</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>部署方式（与领导者选举完全相同）</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>3 台服务器（node1、node2、node3）</li>
<li>安装 ZooKeeper 集群（同前）</li>
<li>打包 JAR：mvn clean package</li>
<li>每台服务器上传 JAR + application.properties</li>
<li>启动脚本（start.sh）同前，但 node.id 不需要了（分布式锁不需要唯一 ID）
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>nohup java -jar distributed-lock-service-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.0</span>-SNAPSHOT.jar &gt; service.log <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> &amp;</pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li><strong>运行方式</strong>：在<strong>任意一台或多台服务器</strong>上启动多个实例（或在同一台机器启动多个进程），模拟并发。</li>
<li><strong>验证</strong>：启动后观察日志，只有<strong>一个线程/进程</strong>能成功扣库存，其他线程要么等待要么超时。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto"><strong>日志示例（运行后可能的输出）</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>订单 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 开始尝试扣库存...
订单 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 开始尝试扣库存...
订单 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 开始尝试扣库存...
...
[INFO] Lock acquired: </span>/locks/inventory/product-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12345</span>   //<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 订单1 抢到锁
[INFO] 扣减成功！扣减数量: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>，剩余库存: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">99</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
[INFO] Lock released: </span>/locks/inventory/product-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12345</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
订单 </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 开始尝试扣库存...
[INFO] Lock acquired: </span>/locks/inventory/product-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12345</span>   //<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 订单4 抢到锁
[INFO] 扣减成功！扣减数量: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>，剩余库存: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">98</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
[INFO] Lock released: </span>/locks/inventory/product-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12345</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
...
最终剩余库存: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span>   // 扣了 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span> 次，库存从 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> -&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90</span>，无超卖</pre>
</div>
<p dir="auto">与领导者选举的对比总结</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="sm">方面</th><th data-col-size="lg">领导者选举（前例）</th><th data-col-size="lg">分布式锁（本例）</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm"><strong>日志出现频率</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">选举只在启动或 Leader 宕机时触发一次</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">每次业务请求都可能触发抢锁/释放日志（高频）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm"><strong>持有锁时间</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">长期（直到宕机）</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">极短（扣库存 50ms + 网络延迟）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm"><strong>日志关键词</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">"I am the Leader"、"I am Follower, watching"</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">"Lock acquired"、"Lock released"、"Failed to acquire"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm"><strong>并发场景</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">所有节点只选一个干活</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">多个节点/线程并发抢同一把锁</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm"><strong>释放时机</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">通常不释放（宕机自动释放）</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">必须在 <code>finally</code> 中释放，否则死锁</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm"><strong>典型日志量</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">少（启动 + 宕机时）</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">多（每个订单都有一条 acquire + release）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>生产环境建议</strong></p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>用 Curator</strong>：原生 ZooKeeper 实现分布式锁容易出错（比如忘记释放、顺序节点管理复杂），Curator 的 InterProcessMutex 可解决。</li>
<li><strong>可重入性</strong>：Curator 锁默认支持可重入（同一线程可多次 acquire）。</li>
<li><strong>公平锁</strong>：默认公平（FIFO），避免饥饿。</li>
<li><strong>锁超时</strong>：业务设置合理超时，避免长时间阻塞。</li>
<li><strong>监控</strong>：监控 ZooKeeper 节点数、Watch 数量、锁竞争频率。</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
